messages:
Nate (FinOps): QuotaScale sent renewal with a new 'min-GPU' line and a "hidden" scaling fee that doesn't match our usage. Can someone take a look? Link: drive.redwood/vendor/quota/renewal-2026 (redacted)

Rhea (Procurement): I see a flat $12k/month min-GPU commitment; last year was $9k. They also added a 2% ops surcharge.

Evan (Infra): Our GPU hours for Q1 show reserved 4,800h. That $/hour jump seems off unless region changed. I can pull per-zone runbook.

QuotaScale (Sales): Hi team — thanks for flagging. The min-GPU increased because we included cross-region warm pools to guarantee failover SLA. We can provide an alternate quote without warm pools (lower commit) if you accept a 30% latency window increase on failover.

Nate (FinOps): Please provide both: (A) current quote with warm pools, (B) no warm pools + fallback SLA, and (C) current + projected 12% growth. Line items must map to our Jan-Mar usage so we can simulate.

Maya (Legal): If the vendor is changing baseline infra between renewals, need contractual language: any mid-term capacity change requires mutual consent. Ask QuotaScale to mark warm-pool as renewal-only or opt-in.

Rhea (Procurement): Also include reconciliation for INV-2026-0724 — they billed a "platform management" fee not in our PO. We want either a credit or a documented rationale.

QuotaScale (Sales): Will return a pro-forma CSV with three variants and reconciliation note on INV-0724 by EOD PT. We can offer a one-time $5k credit if the fee was applied in error.

Evan (Infra): For the simulation, include per-model token breakdown (embeddings vs generation) and assumed batching efficiency. That changes per-token cost dramatically.

Nate (FinOps): Also show unit math inline, e.g., "reserved: $12k -> 4,800h = $2.50/hour" so we can audit.

QuotaScale (Sales): Understood. I'll include per-model lines, assumptions, and an audit log excerpt mapping billed hours to our request_ids.

Rhea (Procurement): Set decision deadline: 2026-04-18. Need signed terms before month-end.

Nate (FinOps): Once pro-forma is in, I'll run a cost-sim and post recommendation.

Maya (Legal): I'll draft the clause on mid-term capacity changes; will review their SOW when posted.

QuotaScale (Sales): Uploading files now. DM if anything missing. :wave:
